meta.title: SCIM 2.0 (HRMS Sync): on failure — admin dashboard shows sync errors
gaps: Configure the SCIM 2.0 HRMS Sync integration with its base URL, bearer token, attribute mapping, and deprovision action.
Make the external SCIM service fail or become unreachable.
Trigger synchronization through an HRMS user create, update, or deprovision event.
Observe the administrator dashboard for the stated sync error, alert, log, or retry record.
Verify that the failed synchronization is not silently dropped.
